Strategy: Refine Best Fit with an exact-fit bonus plus worst-fit fallback: an exact fit scores above everything else, while among non-exact bins the loosest bin wins instead of the tightest. The choice differs from Best Fit whenever no exact fit exists, since Best Fit takes the tightest bin and this rule takes the loosest. Saving tight bins may help future small items fit, but spreading items across loose bins can waste space and open bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(1000 if r == item else r) for r in bins]
```
